title: USF ADR Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for USF Architecture Decision Records (rank-2 authority). Enforces that an ADR is a traceable normative decision, not generic prose: it carries semantic/source/proof/validator references, invariants, permitted changes, forbidden drift, consequences, and explicit AI-alignment rules. Governs the ontology concepts ADR and Semantic Contract. Reference resolution (every ref resolves to a real artefact/decision) is a validator responsibility deferred per schema-authoring-standard §24. lifecycleState draft; not active.

id.$comment: Zero-padded numeric prefix plus kebab title, per directory-and-file-naming-standard §13.

decisionStatus.$comment: An ADR is binding only when accepted; superseded/rejected/deprecated are non-binding lineage.

semanticRefs.$comment: Untraced decisions are not binding: at least one semantic reference is required.
